title: Integration heatmap & weekly sync — SE + ProServices
content:
Weekly sync — SE + ProServices (heatmap format)
Date: 2029-11-12
Owner: Maya Patel
Attendees: Maya, Ethan, Lena, Samir, Ivy (partial)

1) Quick pulse (top-line)
- Green: 3 customers (on track for production rollout next week)
- Yellow: 4 customers (minor infra or config work; target mitigations in 48–72h)
- Red: 2 customers (blocking model mismatch / data contract issues)
- Capacity note: Dedicated pool utilization at 72% across EMEA + NA; forecasting a 5% bump for next week due to BoltForms pilot.

2) Heatmap summary (prioritization grid)
- High urgency / High impact: CardinalRetail (payment vector), Aurelia Financial (PII mapping)
- High urgency / Low impact: MapleAI (small burst of traffic, simple fix)
- Low urgency / High impact: Northstar Analytics (large query volumes, batching optimization)
- Low / Low: internal sandbox customers (deferred)

3) Per-customer snapshot (focused notes)
- CardinalRetail — status: RED
  - Issue: Tokenization mismatch on product feed -> repeated hallucinations in recommendation responses.
  - Root cause hypothesis: upstream feed schema changed; tokenizer config not aligned with model I/O.
  - Action items: SE (Ethan) to push PR with tokenizer shim (SE-789) by 11/14; ProServices (Lena) to validate sample payloads with Cardinal until 11/15.
  - Risk: If unresolved, rollout pause for scheduled Black Friday can’t proceed. Escalated to Solutions leadership.

- Aurelia Financial — status: RED
  - Issue: PII redaction rules failing in Azure private deployment; audit logs show missing KMS key mapping for some footprints.
  - Notes: Private control plane shows stale KMS ARN for 2 nodes. Workaround: rotate keys and rebind in test cluster.
  - Action items: Infra (Samir) to rotate keys in staging and run end-to-end audit by 11/13; Customer security call set 11/13 10:00 PT.

- Northstar Analytics — status: YELLOW
  - Issue: 95th percentile latency spikes at 1.2s (target 850ms) under peak queries.
  - Investigation: batching window too short for their traffic pattern; auto-batcher not reaching expected grouping.
  - Action items: Runtime (GH PR #1982) to add adaptive batching thresholds for 3p analytics by 11/16; SE to recommend temporary rate cap to Northstar (done).

- MapleAI — status: YELLOW
  - Issue: minor prompt sanitization bug causing trailing tokens to repeat on long prompts.
  - Action items: SE to deploy prompt preprocessor patch (small) today; monitor.

- BoltForms — status: GREEN (pilot)
  - Pilot start: 11/14 planned.
  - Notes: reserved capacity allocated (burst policy enabled), preflight checks passed. Confirm spike autoscale policy one hour before go-live.

4) Blockers & escalations
- Blocker: CardinalRetail must be resolved before 11/20. If PR doesn’t stabilize logs within 48h, escalate to on-call platform and consider temporary canary rollback.
- Blocker: Aurelia KMS mapping — requires SOC approval post-rotation; legal loop may add 24–48h. Keep customer updated.

5) Engineering deep-dive notes (technical)
- Adaptive batching prototype: results from bench tests show 9% cost reduction with negligible latency tail increase for 3 customer patterns; Plan: A/B rollout on Northstar and one internal sandbox next week.
- KV cache eviction tweak: telemetry shows cache churn for long-conversation customers. Proposed: increase max per-session KV to 1.5x for dedicated pools (PR in review: PROJ-4678).

6) Operational runbook updates (short)
- Added step for KMS rotation checklist for private deployments (confluence id CONFLUENCE-INT-HEATMAP-42).
- Added temporary diagnostic toggle to increase batch window for a single customer without cluster-wide change. Docs: link in linked_artifacts.

7) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Ethan: tokenizer shim PR (SE-789) for CardinalRetail — due 2029-11-14 (high priority).
- Samir: rotate KMS keys in staging for Aurelia + run audit — due 2029-11-13.
- Lena: customer verification call notes and sample payload validation for CardinalRetail — due 2029-11-15.
- Runtime team: merge adaptive batching PR and deploy to canary for Northstar — due 2029-11-16.
- Maya: prepare contingency runbook for Black Friday scenarios (CardinalRetail) — due 2029-11-13.

8) Risks & mitigations (short)
- Risk: simultaneous high-priority issues (CardinalRetail + Aurelia) could exceed on-call capacity during Black Friday.
  - Mitigation: pre-approved overtime for SE leads + standby contract with infra partner for emergency capacity.
- Risk: Legal/SOC delay on KMS rotation.
  - Mitigation: ProServices to provide interim audit snapshot and customer-facing risk statement.

9) Notes to self / followups
- Collect logs for tokenizer errors and attach to PROJ-4523 (Ethan).
- Confirm that telemetry dashboard includes per-customer KV miss rate (Ivy to follow).
- Schedule a focused 30-min triage on 11/13 for Cardinal + Aurelia (calendar invite pending).

10) Next sync
- Regular weekly sync: 2029-11-19 09:30 PT.
- If Cardinal remains red, move to daily 15-min check-ins until resolved.

---
Informal/working notes below (scratch):
- quick thought: could we use per-customer adaptive cache window instead of global? might reduce churn for large LLM customers.
- backlog: add dedicated test harness for tokenization edge-cases (unicode, emoticons, currency symbols).

End of brief.
